newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Creditanstalt takes over Romania broker.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt takes over Romania broker.

text.p: Creditanstalt Securities SA, a unit of Creditanstalt Bankverein, has taken over a local broker to penetrate the nascent Romanian capital market more effectively, a company executive said.

"We took over Romanian securities company Hera SA, which had a place on the stock exchange floor and was also a direct user of the (over-the-counter) RASDAQ system," Marcel Cobuz, President of the administration council of Creditanstalt Securities (CASA), told Reuters on Tuesday.
He declined to reveal the price of the acquisition.
"It is our wish to offer quality products in the brokerage sector as the local capital market gains ground," Cobuz said.
CASA expects to join trading on the Bucharest bourse and on the RASDAQ market later this week.

CASA will also become involved in the primary market, handling public offers and private placements. It will perform research and analysis, temporary custodian services for foreign investors and market-making business services, Cobuz said.
He said CASA will serve foreign institutional clients, as well as industrial and venture capital investors.
The company has plans to open an office in the Transylvanian city of Cluj to offer retail brokerage services.
